gaming.desc: Everything the catalog offers for games: processor priority, network, graphics, power, and background services.
gaming.title: Gaming preset

recommended.desc: What suits most machines and takes effect right away — nothing that needs a Windows restart.
recommended.title: Recommended

optimize.revertConfirmBody: You are about to undo {{revert}} already applied optimization(s) and apply {{apply}}. The items below will go back to the value Windows had before, captured when they were applied.
optimize.revertItemDetail: Goes back to the value captured before it was applied.
optimize.revertSingleBody: This optimization will go back to the value Windows had before it was applied.

disableDynamicTick.desc: Turns off the dynamic boot timer tick so clock intervals stay constant. Requires a restart.
disableDynamicTick.title: Disable the dynamic timer tick

platformClock.desc: Removes the boot setting that pins one clock source and lets Windows choose the best one available again.
platformClock.title: Stop forcing the platform clock

platformTick.desc: Makes Windows use the motherboard's hardware timer, keeping clock intervals more predictable.
platformTick.title: Use the platform timer

gamesTaskPriority.desc: Raises the processor and graphics priority Windows grants to tasks registered as games.
gamesTaskPriority.title: Scheduler priority for games

systemResponsiveness.desc: Lowers the share of the processor the multimedia scheduler holds back for background tasks and hands it to the foreground application.
systemResponsiveness.title: Reserve less CPU for background work

win32PrioritySeparation.desc: Gives the foreground application short, fixed quanta, favouring games and the active window.
win32PrioritySeparation.title: Boost the foreground application

fullscreenExclusive.desc: Makes games use exclusive fullscreen instead of the Windows fullscreen optimizations.
fullscreenExclusive.title: Force fullscreen exclusive

gameMode.desc: Lets Windows prioritise the running game and hold back updates and notifications.
gameMode.title: Windows Game Mode

hardwareScheduling.desc: Hands video memory scheduling to the graphics card itself. Only available where the display driver offers the feature.
hardwareScheduling.title: Hardware-accelerated GPU scheduling

tcpParameters.desc: Applies a set of TCP stack parameters aimed at low-latency connections and more simultaneous ports.
tcpParameters.title: Tune the Windows TCP parameters

throttlingIndex.desc: Removes the ceiling the multimedia scheduler puts on network traffic while audio or video is playing.
throttlingIndex.title: Turn off multimedia network throttling

sysMain.desc: Sets SysMain (Superfetch) to Manual start, cutting background disk activity.
sysMain.title: SysMain on Manual start

powerPlan.desc: Activates the Ultimate Performance plan, or High performance when the machine does not have it. Draws more power on a laptop.
powerPlan.title: High-performance power plan

visualEffects.desc: Trades the interface animations and shadows for the best-performance setting.
visualEffects.title: Visual effects tuned for performance

protection.desc: Windows System Protection is turned off. Without it VeloSys Pro cannot create the restore point that precedes every optimization, and changes would be applied with no safety net.
protection.manualPath: Rather do it yourself? Control Panel → System → System Protection → select the Windows drive → Configure → Turn on system protection.
protection.title: Enable System Protection before optimizing
